The '''Lector's Outfit''' was a specialized set of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] designed to assist [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] in delivering speeches with little preparation. It included several small, powerful [[Speaker/Legends|speakers]] and a collar [[Microphone/Legends|microphone]] that amplified the wearer's voice, ensuring it reached even the furthest listeners. While politicians typically used large-scale systems for major addresses, this outfit proved invaluable when quick thinking and immediate audibility were needed in impromptu situations.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lector's Outfit was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
